description: Outbuilding at rear for use incidental to main dwelling
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp;Planning statement, Reasonable exception statement, 2024105.OBPA109 rev P01, 2024105.OBPA101 rev P01, 2024105.OBPA102 rev P01, CIL form

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s), other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in the flank elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.

<p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">The outbuild</span>ing hereby permitted shall only be used for purposes ancillary to the use of the main dwellinghouse at&nbsp;<a href="https://harrow-planning.idoxcloud.com/locations/index.html?fa=edit&amp;id=2095892" target="_blank" data-id="2095892" class="trigger_location_popup no-underline" style=""><span data-update-object-name="Location" data-update-object-id="2095892" data-update-field-name="dtf_location_id">74 Morley Crescent East, Stanmore, Harrow, HA7 2LQ</span></a>&nbsp;and shall not be used, let or sublet as a separate self contained residential unit.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

The window(s) in the proposed development shall:
(a) be of purpose-made obscure glass,
(b) be permanently fixed closed below a height of 1.7m above finished floor level,
and shall thereafter be retained in that form.
